sloka: द्विजाति चरितः धर्मः शास्त्र दृष्टः सनातनः ।यदि ते धर्म निरते त्वया पुत्रे विवासिते ॥२-६१-२३॥
transliteration: dvijāti caritaḥ dharmaḥ śāstra dṛṣṭaḥ sanātanaḥ ।yadi te dharma nirate tvayā putre vivāsite ॥2-61-23॥

translations.english: Even if all the worlds were to unite and fight against him, he will not fear. This righteous Rama will reestablish justice in this unrighteous world.
